question: Does the system retain broad experiment authority without treating authorization as capability, waiving resource controls or changing unrelated resources?
cases: Exact policy bytes and hash are included in admitted builder prompts and receipts
Controller/worker policy mismatch stops before inference
Native command mode remains full inside the assigned environment
Cloud resource approval, original budget/deadline and fresh reviews remain required
Actual native write/exec/read/resume still works with the policy
pass_criteria: Every declared mechanical case passes; existing backend and infrastructure checks pass. No cloud mutation, prompt publication or deployment in this campaign.
limitations: Policy and execution regressions do not establish actual-model compliance, support for every future experiment, or scientific validity. Live AI evaluation and operational release checks remain required.
